The '''''Crest of Dawn''''' was a space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was owned by [[Cularin Star Tours]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Syub Kyak]] and his family hired it for their vacation. However, his children rewired the navigational controls, causing it to get stuck in a radiation storm on [[Genarius]]. Syub sent out a distress call and the CST safety ship ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' arrived and was able to save the ''Crest''. It was then flown to the nearby floating city of [[Edic Bar]], so that repairs could be made to it.
